name: Repro: downsample(max) on sparse session_window output
description: Reproduces the bug where downsample(1D, max) on a sparse 1Min session_window series returns all NaN. Compares downsample path vs where(closed) path.
source:
src = market_data_source()()
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# === SESSION WINDOW (RTH 9:30-16:00 ET) ===
rth_sw = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(src.o, high, low, close)

# Session range in points — SPARSE: only non-null on rth_sw.closed bar
session_range = rth_sw.high - rth_sw.low

# === PATH A: downsample(max) on sparse series — THE BUG ===
daily_range_downsampled_raw = resample(session_range, target_timeframe=1D, agg=["Max"])
daily_range_downsampled = daily_range_downsampled_raw[0]

# === PATH B: where(closed) snapshot — THE FIX ===
daily_range_where = where(rth_sw.closed, session_range)

# === REPORTERS: compare both paths ===
xy_lines(
    title='Path A: downsample(max) — Expected All NaN',
    category='Comparison',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Downsampled Range', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=daily_range_downsampled)

xy_lines(
    title='Path B: where(closed) — Expected Valid Data',
    category='Comparison',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Session Range', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=daily_range_where)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Path Comparison',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['downsample(max)', 'where(closed)'],
        col_headers=['Count (non-NaN)', 'Mean Range'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Comparison'
)(daily_range_downsampled, daily_range_downsampled, daily_range_where, daily_range_where)
